title: Bruno Sammartino vs. Larry Zbyszko
summary: A pupil attacks the mentor whose shadow he wants to escape. Bruno’s pursuit of Zbyszko builds to a steel cage at Shea Stadium.

chapters.title: Zbyszko turns on his mentor
chapters.result: Zbyszko attacks Sammartino with a chair after their match breaks down.
chapters.context: Television airdate; the match was taped earlier. The attack transforms a mentor-pupil dispute into a grudge feud.

chapters.title: Bruno gets his cage-match revenge
chapters.result: Sammartino defeats Zbyszko inside a steel cage.
chapters.context: The stadium match supplies the decisive milestone in this selected account.
